name: HOLLOW THRONE: Neural Conquest Sim
description: A full BCI-integrated grand strategy game in which players inhabit the minds of historical and speculative rulers, experiencing the sensory and emotional weight of command decisions through layered neural feedback — the taste of poisoned court air, the physical exhaustion of campaign marches, the visceral shame of surrender. HOLLOW THRONE's 'Sovereign Skin' technology briefly became an industry benchmark, allowing players to feel the social pressure of their court as a literal change in ambient temperature and weight against the skin. The game's controversial 'Collapse Arc' expansion, set during the nation-state dissolution of 2041-2078, was praised by historians and denounced by three sitting corponation governance boards.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive becomes so immersed in the game's 'Collapse Arc' that she begins applying pre-Sable negotiation tactics to her actual corporate division, with alarming effectiveness.
Someone has modded HOLLOW THRONE to include a perfectly accurate simulation of a current corponation's internal power structure — the source of that data is unknown and deeply concerning.
A historian hired to consult on the game's 'Collapse Arc' discovers that one historical branch of the simulation contains events that haven't happened yet.
